name: Anardana Goli Mouth Freshener – 180gm
original_description:
Anardana Goli Mouth Freshener, a delightful creation in the form of small, spherical candies meticulously crafted from a fusion of natural elements, prominently featuring anardana, or dried pomegranate seeds. Anardana, esteemed for its zesty and citrusy essence, holds a revered position in both traditional Indian culinary traditions and medicinal remedies.

Indulge in Anardana Goli, and savor a burst of tangy and revitalizing flavor that expertly counters undesirable breath. These candies, conveniently compact, are your perfect companions for freshening up on the go.

Benefits of Anardana Goli Mouth Freshener:

  • Perfect for aiding digestion and breath rejuvenation post-meals.
  • Comprising petite, spherical candies crafted from all-natural ingredients, prominently featuring anardana.
  • Anardana, celebrated for its zesty and citrusy profile, is a cornerstone of traditional Indian gastronomy and herbal practices.

Ingredients:

  1. Dried pomegranate seeds
  2. Amchur powder
  3. Black salt
  4. Sugar powder
